installer.check: The published install-desktop.sh verified the ZIP from a local mirror of the release assets and installed it into a scratch home. The installed app started its bundled backend and completed the seeded Replay turn.

wire.check: The published ZIP's bundled backend passed the standalone checker on a fresh seeded loopback server with a read-only token.

replay.check: A fresh Showcase turn over Effect RPC v2 retained its three messages, original send receipt, completed run and typed denial across reconnect, retry and read-only access.

chromiumSettledRepeat.scope: settled replay in the recorded Chromium profile

electronSettledHover.scope: settled Replay thread with both panels closed and the reply action bar hovered

firefoxLinuxSettledRepeat.scope: settled replay in the recorded Linux arm64 Firefox ESR profile

firefoxLinuxMigrationHead.scope: The first Firefox ESR capture matched the published pixels and action trace on both locally built installs. Later captures varied across builds and all three timed attempts ended early.

firefoxLinuxSynchronized.scope: Settled Firefox ESR on Debian arm64 with a synchronized subscription and the transcript at the end of its scroll range. The archived fixture has no configured provider. All four timing comparisons passed with 24 measured samples per install.

firefoxMacosSynchronized.scope: Stock Firefox 161.0 on macOS arm64 in four independent headless profiles. Both v0.1.17 copies match exactly. All four timing comparisons passed with 24 measured samples per install. Cross-build parity fails on the Poteto control and the shifted Showcase button.

electronMigrationHead.scope: Settled Replay in the pinned macOS dark Electron profile. The delta is the Poteto composer control introduced by trunk 386d27b4. Timing passed against incumbent A and exceeded the budget against incumbent B.

electronMigrationHeadRepeat.scope: The two incumbent installations and the two migration-head installations each matched within their build. The cross-source difference remains confined to the composer. One migration-head installation exceeded the 15% limit against both incumbents and stayed within the 2 s absolute limit.

electronPersistentCapture.scope: One macOS dark Electron profile with 48 measured rounds per installation. Both copies of the package built at 9982ba07 met the capture timing limits against both published copies. Each build reproduced its earlier decoded pixels. The cross-build composer difference remained.

chromiumMigrationHead.scope: Settled Replay in the recorded Chromium headless profile. The delta is the Poteto composer control introduced by trunk 386d27b4.

macosPackageFormats.scope: Published macOS ZIP and DMG payloads match by architecture. The translated desktop installer selected arm64. The Intel ZIP CLI served protocol 2 under Rosetta. Both DMG runs opened the saved thread and preserved the Replay payloads. The arm64 capture settled, and the translated Intel capture timed out waiting for highlighted code.

linuxInstallers.scope: Published CLI shell installer, desktop shell installer and Debian package on both Linux architectures. The arm64 AppImage booted in extract-and-run mode. The emulated x64 AppImage runtime exited 127 and its extracted AppRun booted. The installed CLI and all four tested desktop payloads opened the copied Replay thread.

ociRuntime.scope: The published linux/arm64 and linux/amd64 manifests each passed the v2 wire check from a fresh data mount and opened the saved Replay thread from a copied mount.

foregroundCliUpgrade.scope: Published Linux foreground CLI upgrade on arm64 and emulated x64. The restarted host preserved the Replay transcript, environment identity, and scoped browser and bearer sessions. Both launchers rejected a deliberately invalid checksum.

linuxArm64AppImageUpdate.scope: Published v0.1.17 to v0.1.18 on Debian 13.8 arm64 under Xvfb. The packaged updater rejected an invalid SHA-512, retried with the published manifest, and relaunched automatically with the same environment and Replay run. The mirror served full downloads on loopback.

linuxDebUpdates.scope: Published v0.1.17 to v0.1.18 on Debian 13.8 arm64 and emulated amd64 under Xvfb. Both packaged updaters rejected the bad SHA-512, then installed and relaunched through sudo and dpkg with the published manifest. The same environment and Replay payloads survived. The fixture used a loopback feed and passwordless sudo.

chatLatencyReference.scope: Published v0.1.17 in the macOS Chromium Browser panel with a controlled mid-turn WebSocket cut. All twelve measured turns preserved the exact table and three ordered rendered messages. Reconnect timing includes the client's automatic retry delay.

navigation.scope: chat link and command palette in the recorded Chromium profile

stopAndRelink.scope: Published served Chromium on macOS. Stopping a Replay Question run awaiting input interrupted that same run and restored the composer. Cookie revocation ended the connection and showed the pairing form on a fresh visit. A new link reopened the same stopped thread.

readOnlyChat.scope: Published and locally built macOS arm64 packages, direct loopback Chromium cookie session. Read-only draft editing remained available, Enter left the draft unsent, and typed denial preserved the projection. The operate-scope control succeeded on both builds. The visible Poteto control differs.

chatReadingPosition.scope: Published and locally built macOS arm64 packages, direct loopback Chromium. The long user-message anchor stayed at 47.75 CSS pixels when the right panel opened. The empty thread focused its composer with zero saved runs and messages. Each build repeated all three images exactly. Cross-build images differ in the composer control row.

hostedHttpsPairing.scope: Local HTTPS hosted build from the published source tag, paired to the installed macOS arm64 v0.1.17 backend in Chromium. The browser observed zero backend request starts through the confirmation capture. The approved link issued one read-only DPoP session, opened the same saved thread after reload, and returned HTTP 401 when reused.

bundledDesktopActivation.scope: One launch per macOS arm64 package with an independent copy of the seed and no active sessions. Each startup link opened the same saved thread through a fresh desktop bearer session on the bundled backend. The launch traces match and the whole-window pixel comparison fails.

clientVersionRejection.scope: real published v0.1.17 HTTP 426 and simulated older boot-service metadata for the client update action

chatViewStates.scope: empty composer, initial thread detail loading and unavailable environment in the recorded Chromium profile

disconnectRecover.scope: isolated packaged host stop and restart with draft and transcript preserved in the same Chromium tab

chatDisplay.scope: macOS arm64 Electron. English light and dark, native 120% zoom, German, and wide and compact sidebars.
